scripts.title: SIGMA FARM  Remastered | Update
scripts.features:
REMASTER
SIGMA HUB — REMASTERED Made by adrijan_matic

Bugs? DM me on Discord: adrijan_matic (ignore the thumbnail, still haven't figured that one out)

A fully remastered, deeply polished farming automation hub. Every system was rebuilt from scratch — smarter walking, cleaner selling, proper configs, and a completely redesigned UI. Uses walking instead of teleporting for every feature by design — the game has an anti-TP system, and getting banned isn't the move.

🔐 Key System Free Work.ink key required to use. Validate once per session, auto-expires and re-prompts when it runs out. Key lasts for 5 hours!

⚙️ Features

Auto Shovel — Digs to 100% quality every time, fast. Very OP.

Auto Pan & Shake — Automatically shakes your pan at the water. Shake priority guaranteed — always finishes to 0% before doing anything else.

Auto Sell — Walks to the nearest NPC seller, sells your unlocked valuables, walks back. Must be within range of a seller.

Auto Lock — Protect specific valuables from being auto-sold. Full searchable list with animated lock toggles.

Auto Manual Walk — Pick your own Sand and Water spots. Walks between them automatically synced to your pan fill level.

Auto Collect Geodes — Collects every Geode on the map and returns you to where you were.

Auto Place Totem — Picks a Totem Spot, detects missing Luck/Strength/Luminant totems and places them automatically. Stays inside totem radius, smart pathing.

Configs — Save, load, overwrite and auto-load your full settings including Auto Lock selections. Never re-enable the same things twice.

Keybind Setup Screen — First-launch guide to make sure your hotkeys are set up correctly before the script runs.

📋 Changelog

[NEW] Key system — Work.ink token required, auto-expiry watchdog

[NEW] Full UI remaster — dark glass theme, animated section labels, glowing toggles, status dot, fill % bar, pill-style dividers

[NEW] Auto Sell completely rewritten — walks to a safe distance in front of merchant, sells and leaves immediately, no more kissing the NPC for 30 seconds

[NEW] Auto Manual Walk — replaces the old buggy Auto Walk with a reliable fill-state-locked system (no more back-and-forth terrain flickering)

[REMOVED] Auto Walk — replaced by Auto Manual Walk which actually works

[FIX] Fixed a lot of bugs.

Added Configs (Save / Load / Overwrite / Set-AutoLoad)

Added "Unselect All" and "Lock Visible" to the Auto Lock filter

Improved Totem system (radius detection, stays inside range, smarter pathing)

Added keybind setup warning screen on startup

Added Shake Priority (always finishes shaking before Sell/Totems/Geodes interrupt)
